items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 58:1
items.html: You already know that the matter of Tzelem is the reflected light that rises at the time of the inclusion of the MAN of the lower one in the screen and coarseness of the upper one. Hence, since in the coupling made upon the MAN of ZON two Partzufim come, Aba and Ima, in this coupling, it follows automatically that there are two phases of screen and coarseness that raise reflected light, namely, on the side of Aba and on the side of Ima. Therefore, a distinction is to be made here between the Tzelem of Aba and the Tzelem of Ima. (Item 142)
